title: Lithotomist
summary: LITHOT'OMIST, noun [See Lithotomy.] One who performs the operation of cutting for the stone in the bladder; or one who is skilled in the operation.

inlines.v: LITHOT'OMIST, noun [See Lithotomy.] One who performs the operation of cutting for the stone in the bladder; or one who is skilled in the operation.
